_about: KPI drill-down rule book (sprint 2026-09-29, item 3; decision D3). The Today tiles' ON TRACK / WATCH / FOCUS bands, the rule for recommending team-leader help, the help topic and the one-sentence action per KPI. The operative copy is DRILL_RULES in worker/src/drill.mjs — change BOTH together; nicks_code/diagnostics/verify-drill.mjs fails on drift. All windows are month-to-date except the named 'last N sessions' driver.

bands._note: pass at or above `pass`, watch at or above `watch`, focus below. ta/qa/att are ratios; aveG is a multiple of the R99 floor's ex-VAT twin (1 = at the floor).

tl_help._note: Recommended when the KPI is below target month-to-date AND either it was below target in >= sessionsBelow of the last ofLast sessions, or closing the gap needs more than paceMultiple x the agent's current daily pace (target achieved only). QA in the focus band always recommends it.

actions.ta: Every session at your daily target from here keeps the month on track — plan each shift around that number.
actions.aveG: Hold every sale at the floor or better — the value of each sale is what this measures, so lead with the full product.
actions.qa: One clean week of calls moves this — ask for your last evaluated call to be reviewed with you.
actions.att: Every day on the floor protects the rest of your card — tell your team leader early if something is keeping you away.
